sources.title: [2112.04215] Self-Supervised Models are Continual Learners
sources.snippet: Self-supervised models have been shown to produce comparable or better visual representations than their supervised counterparts when trained offline on unlabeled data at scale. However, their efficacy is catastrophically reduced in a Continual Learning (CL) scenario where data is presented to the model sequentially.
